title: Oozing Kenyan Yogurt Flatbread
description: A fermented, molten flatbread with honey-infused yogurt filling, layered with delicate buttery lamination for a comforting bite.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Add warm water and yogurt, then mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth.
Let the dough rise in a warmed place for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into four equal pieces and roll each into a thin circle.
Fold each circle in half, roll again to create a layered effect, and seal the edges.
Brush the top with olive oil and sprinkle lightly with cornstarch.
Place the flatbreads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until golden and the layers puff up.
Brush the tops with honey, flip halfway, and bake for an additional 5 minutes while letting the yogurt inside ooze gently.
Serve warm, garnished with dried mint if desired.
